title: Recover a Tree From Preorder Traversal
summary: Given a string representing the preorder traversal of a binary tree, where each node's depth is indicated by dashes followed by the node's value, reconstruct the tree and return its root.
statement: Given a string representing the preorder traversal of a binary tree, where each node's depth is indicated by dashes followed by the node's value, reconstruct the tree and return its root. If a node has only one child, it is the left child.
constraints: Dash count before a value is its depth; a single child is always left.
Return the reconstructed binary tree root.

reference_solution:
def recover_preorder_tree(traversal):
 stack=[];at=0
 while at<len(traversal):
  depth=0
  while at<len(traversal) and traversal[at]=='-':depth+=1;at+=1
  end=at
  while end<len(traversal) and traversal[end].isdigit():end+=1
  node=TreeNode(int(traversal[at:end]));at=end
  while len(stack)>depth:stack.pop()
  if stack:
   if stack[-1].left is None:stack[-1].left=node
   else:stack[-1].right=node
  stack.append(node)
 return stack[0]
